metadata.description: Curated subset of the iteration-5 'transplanting the base model's plan' experiment (Qwen/Qwen3-8B recipient, Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base donor): the frozen Stage-4 confirmation slots of the two decisive tasks with the clearest outcomes, T14 (top-k frequent; the one PASS) and T03 (k-th smallest; matched-norm random beats the transplant).
metadata.slots: S2 confirmation slots j = 10-19 x templates W1-W5 = 50 common-random-number slots per task

fields.input: the rendered user prompt (identical token ids for every arm of the slot)
fields.output: TWIN (unhooked Qwen3-8B) on the slot, as 'label|pass'
fields.predict_<arm>: hooked arm on the same slot: T<lam> transplant, MR<lam> norm-matched random, XT<lam> cross-task base shift, MRP<lam> pass-matched random
fields.metadata_code_<arm>: the program that arm generated on the slot ('' when none was extracted)

branches: specificity failed (READ moves or collapsed tasks move)

stats.note: the template-cluster bootstrap with 5 clusters is anti-conservative; coverage is reported

    return heap[0]
